data.name: InnKeeper
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

By day, you run a tavern.
By night, you defend it from the undead.

Set in a stylized medieval fantasy world, this action roguelike tavern management game blends brutal melee combat with hands-on tavern simulation. When darkness falls, hordes of zombies and monsters descend on your establishment. Armed with sword and shield, you must fight to survive and protect the tavern you worked so hard to build.

When morning comes, the doors open again.

Serve customers, take orders, deliver food and drinks, and keep the tavern running while travelers and townsfolk fill your tables. Earn gold during the day and use it wisely — because when night returns, the tavern becomes a battlefield.

Spend your profits on upgrades, equipment, and improvements that help you survive the next night. Visit wandering vendors like the Blacksmith, Priest, and Merchant to strengthen your character, improve your gear, and prepare for the dangers ahead.

Each night grows more dangerous, and each day gives you new opportunities to expand your tavern, improve your defenses, and push your survival further.

Run the tavern.
Survive the night.
Repeat… if you can.

Run Your Tavern

During the day, your tavern opens for business.
Serve customers, take orders, deliver food and drinks, and keep the place running while the town’s visitors fill your tables.

Work the Tavern Floor

Handle the chaos of a busy tavern: manage customers, fulfill orders, and keep the drinks flowing while earning the gold you’ll need to survive the next night.

Fight Through the Night

When darkness falls, the real trouble begins.
Defend your tavern against waves of undead using fast-paced sword and shield melee combat inspired by action RPG and souls-like mechanics.

Upgrade Your Character

Buy weapons, upgrades, and blessings from vendors like the Blacksmith, Priest, and Merchant to prepare for the dangers ahead.

Day & Night Gameplay Loop

A gameplay cycle where daytime tavern management funds your survival at night.

Stylized Medieval Fantasy World

A dark yet playful world filled with wandering merchants, strange customers, and relentless undead hordes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
Violence and Combat

This game contains combat where the player fights and defeats undead creatures such as zombies and monsters using melee weapons like swords and shields. Defeated enemies disappear after combat. The game features stylized fantasy violence but does not include graphic gore or realistic depictions of injury.
